title: Dev sandbox mockups for stepwise auth, key rotation, streaming, and tool-calls
creator: Nina Gomez
description: Create a set of compact, developer-focused mockups and animated frames that walk users through first-run SDK/API onboarding scenarios inside the in-product sandbox. Focus areas: 1) stepwise API key provisioning (create, store, rotate), 2) streaming/response preview with cancel/rewind affordances, 3) tool-calling example flow showing function registration and example responses, and 4) network/permission states (offline, 401, rate-limited) with helpful remediation copy. Deliverables are static hero screens, 3 micro-animations (GIF/MP4), and a set of cropped screenshots for docs and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero screens (auth, streaming, tool-call) in 1440x900 and 1024x640 variants
Three micro-animations demonstrating: key rotation flow, streaming chunk arrival with progress, tool-call result mapping
All screens include keyboard-focused snippets and a small ‘Try in sandbox’ CTA
Error-state variants for 401, expired-key, and offline with suggested next steps
Figma file with clearly labeled components and export-ready frames; assets uploaded to Drive with export presets
